LOGIC ADVENTURE 19 · CLASS 30

Koala’s Sorting Station

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Sorting by shape

Six toys, three boxes — sort every toy by its shape, not its color!

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · SORTING BY SHAPE

Koala’s Sorting Station

Sort the toys by shape! Tap a toy, then tap the box with the matching shape.

Tap a toy, then tap the box with the same shape.

The station is sorted!

Triangles to the triangle box, squares to the square box, circles to the circle box.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

The trick here is deliberate: colors clash on purpose (a red toy does NOT go in the red box). Say the shape aloud with each tap — "triangle goes to the triangle box!"

Prefer paper? The Koala’s Sorting Station worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
